findings.claim: A 2005 law guaranteeing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households...
findings.problem: Out of date. MGNREGA was replaced by the Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 (VB-G RAM G). The President gave assent on 21 Dec 2025, and MGNREGA ceased to apply from 1 July 2026. The new Act guarantees 125 days. On 11 Oct 2026 the present tense ('guaranteeing', 'is entitled') is wrong.

fix.en: A 2005 law that guaranteed at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households whose adults volunteered for unskilled manual work. From 1 July 2026 it was replaced by the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, which guarantees 125 days.
fix.hi: यह 2005 का कानून था, जो अकुशल शारीरिक श्रम के इच्छुक ग्रामीण परिवारों को वित्तीय वर्ष में कम से कम 100 दिन मजदूरी वाले रोजगार की गारंटी देता था। 1 जुलाई 2026 से इसकी जगह VB-G RAM G अधिनियम, 2025 ने ली, जो 125 दिन की गारंटी देता है।

findings.evidence: https://www.outlookmoney.com/news/vb-g-ram-g-act-replaces-mgnrega-implementation-to-take-effect-from-july-1 ; https://www.onmanorama.com/news/india/2025/12/21/viksit-bharat-guarantee-rural-employment-president-assent.amp.html (the editor should confirm against the gazette on egazette.gov.in / pib.gov.in)

findings.problem: This was true under MGNREGA (Section 7). It should be in the past tense, or the pack should be reframed around the new Act. Check the new Act's timeframe before stating a number for it.

fix.en: Under MGNREGA, if work was not given within 15 days of applying, the applicant was entitled to an unemployment allowance.
fix.hi: MGNREGA के तहत, यदि आवेदन के 15 दिन के भीतर काम न मिलता, तो आवेदक को बेरोजगारी भत्ता पाने का अधिकार था।

findings.evidence: MGNREGA 2005, Section 7; see the replacement evidence above

findings.claim: Revision card on MGNREGA
findings.problem: An exam-relevant twist is now missing: aspirants should learn both the old Act and its replacement. Consider a companion card on VB-G RAM G.

findings.claim: The Fifteenth Finance Commission, chaired by N.K. Singh, recommended states a 41 percent share of the divisible pool.
findings.problem: The fact is correct, but it is out of date for 2026-27 answers. The Sixteenth Finance Commission, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, covers 2026-31; its report was tabled in Feb 2026 and keeps the states' share at 41 percent. A Mains answer written in 2026 should cite the current Commission.

fix.en: The Sixteenth Finance Commission, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, kept the states' share of the divisible pool at 41 percent for 2026-31, the same as the Fifteenth (N.K. Singh).
fix.hi: सोलहवें वित्त आयोग ने, अरविंद पनगढ़िया की अध्यक्षता में, 2026-31 के लिए राज्यों का विभाज्य कोष में हिस्सा 41 प्रतिशत ही रखा, जितना पंद्रहवें (एन.के. सिंह) ने रखा था।

findings.evidence: https://superkalam.com/current-affairs/12-02-2026/have-states-gained-from-the-16th-fc-pg10-7fcbd66a-8110-4abf-be4d-4316a94ae214 (the editor should confirm on fincomindia.nic.in / the Budget 2026-27 papers)

findings.claim: Not justiciable, so courts cannot enforce equal pay.
findings.problem: Misleading. Article 39(d) is not enforceable on its own. But since Randhir Singh v. Union of India (1982), the Supreme Court has enforced 'equal pay for equal work' by reading Article 39(d) with Articles 14 and 16 (also State of Punjab v. Jagjit Singh, 2016). 'Courts cannot enforce equal pay' would mislead in a Prelims statement question.

fix.en: Part IV Directive Principle, not enforceable by itself. The Supreme Court has, however, enforced equal pay by reading it with Articles 14 and 16 (Randhir Singh, 1982).
fix.hi: भाग IV का नीति निदेशक तत्व, जो अपने आप में न्यायालय में लागू नहीं कराया जा सकता। फिर भी सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने इसे अनुच्छेद 14 और 16 के साथ पढ़कर समान वेतन लागू कराया है (रणधीर सिंह, 1982)।

findings.evidence: Randhir Singh v. Union of India, (1982) 1 SCC 618; State of Punjab v. Jagjit Singh, (2017) 1 SCC 148

findings.claim: Balban and colleagues, Stanford study (2023)
findings.problem: Source mismatch. Balban et al. (Cell Reports Medicine, 2023) compared cyclic sighing, box breathing, cyclic hyperventilation and mindfulness. It did not test 4-in/6-out slow breathing at about six breaths a minute. Citing it here implies evidence the study does not give, which also brushes against the no-health-claims rule.

fix.en: Slow-breathing practice; no specific study cited
fix.hi: धीमी साँस का अभ्यास; किसी विशेष अध्ययन का हवाला नहीं

findings.evidence: Balban MY et al., 'Brief structured respiration practices enhance mood and reduce physiological arousal', Cell Rep Med 2023;4(1):100895

findings.claim: नाक से लगभग 4 सेकंड साँस लीजिए
findings.problem: The Hindi adds 'through the nose', which the English does not have. The Hindi beats also add 'लगभग' ('about').

fix.en: Breathe in through your nose for about 4 seconds and out for about 6.

findings.claim: {inhale:4, hold:2, exhale:6}
findings.problem: The data contradicts the script. The beats describe a double inhale (a long breath in, then a short top-up) followed by a long exhale, with no hold. If the app renders 'hold 2 s' from this field, the screen will contradict the narration.

fix.en: Model the pace as inhale 4, top-up inhale 2 (no hold), exhale 6; or set pace to null as in the grounding script.

findings.evidence: Script beats[1..6]; Balban et al. 2023 describe cyclic sighing without a breath hold

findings.claim: Anyone can still cook rasgulla at home. Only producers from the registered area can sell it under the protected name.
findings.problem: Misleading. 'Rasgulla' itself is not a protected name. Two GIs exist: 'Banglar Rasogolla' (West Bengal, 2017) and 'Odisha Rasagola' (2019). Anyone may sell plain 'rasgulla'. Also, only registered authorised users, not every producer in the area, may use a GI.

fix.en: Anyone can still cook rasgulla at home, or sell it as rasgulla. But only authorised producers from Odisha can sell it as 'Odisha Rasagola', a registered GI.
fix.hi: रसगुल्ला घर पर कोई भी बना सकता है, और रसगुल्ला नाम से बेच भी सकता है। पर 'ओडिशा रसगोला' नाम से, जो एक पंजीकृत GI है, सिर्फ़ ओडिशा के अधिकृत उत्पादक ही बेच सकते हैं।

findings.evidence: GI Registry journal entries: Banglar Rasogolla (2017), Odisha Rasagola (2019); GI Act 1999, Sections 17 and 21 (authorised users)

findings.claim: ...and India is a signatory.
findings.problem: Imprecise. The Sendai Framework is a non-binding agreement that UN member states adopted at the Third UN World Conference (March 2015), and the UN General Assembly endorsed it (A/RES/69/283). It is not a treaty that countries sign.

fix.en: ...adopted by UN member states, including India, at a UN conference in Sendai, Japan, in 2015.
fix.hi: ...इसे 2015 में जापान के सेंडाई में संयुक्त राष्ट्र सम्मेलन में भारत समेत संयुक्त राष्ट्र के सदस्य देशों ने अपनाया।

findings.claim: Needs amendments to ... (Articles 83, 85, 172 and 174)
findings.problem: Check the article list. The Kovind High-Level Committee and the Constitution (One Hundred and Twenty-Ninth Amendment) Bill, 2024 propose inserting a new Article 82A and amending Articles 83, 172 and 327. Articles 85 and 174 (summoning, prorogation and dissolution) were in the 2018 Law Commission draft, but the Bill does not touch them. The bill is now with a Joint Parliamentary Committee, a current hook that the card does not mention.

fix.en: Needs constitutional amendments: the 2024 Bill would insert Article 82A and amend Articles 83, 172 and 327
fix.hi: संविधान संशोधन ज़रूरी: 2024 का विधेयक अनुच्छेद 82A जोड़ेगा और अनुच्छेद 83, 172 और 327 में संशोधन करेगा

findings.evidence: https://prsindia.org/billtrack/the-constitution-one-hundred-and-twenty-ninth-amendment-bill-2024 (editor to confirm); Kovind HLC report, March 2024

findings.claim: Under Article 200, the Governor has four options. ... Two: withhold assent.
findings.problem: The bare text of Article 200 lists four courses. But the Supreme Court holds that withholding must be followed by returning the bill to the House: see State of Punjab v. Principal Secretary to the Governor (2023), and the Constitution Bench opinion in the Presidential Reference of 20 Nov 2025, para 99: 'the first proviso conditions the verb withhold, to mean withhold and return to the Legislature'. Presenting 'withhold' as a standalone pocket veto would mislead Mains aspirants. Keep the four options from the text, but add the Court's reading.

fix.en: Two: withhold assent. The Supreme Court has held that a Governor who withholds assent must return the bill to the House (2023; Presidential Reference, 2025).
fix.hi: दूसरा: सहमति रोक लेना। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के अनुसार सहमति रोकने पर राज्यपाल को विधेयक सदन को लौटाना होगा (2023; राष्ट्रपति संदर्भ, 2025)।

findings.evidence: https://cjp.org.in/a-constitutional-reset-on-governor-assent-the-supreme-courts-opinion-in-the-presidential-reference-on-articles-200-201/ ; https://www.scobserver.in/cases/presidential-reference-on-powers-of-the-governor-and-president/ ; State of Punjab v. Principal Secretary to the Governor of Punjab, 2023 INSC 1009

fix.en: Part XVIII (Articles 352 to 360). The three types are in Articles 352, 356 and 360.
fix.hi: भाग XVIII (अनुच्छेद 352 से 360)। तीनों प्रकार अनुच्छेद 352, 356 और 360 में हैं।
